title: Is the Importance Ratio Necessary for Stable Reinforcement Learning in LLMs?
abstract: arXiv:2611.15404v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become central to post-training large language models (LLMs). However, popular RL methods like GRPO incur non-negligible overhead by computing both old-policy and current-policy likelihoods to form importance sampling ratios. In this work, we propose Likelihood-Gated Policy Optimization (LGPO), which enforces a soft trust region constraint via likelihood-based gating, eliminating the need to compute old-policy likelihoods. Empirically, we show that removing the importance sampling correction term does not harm training stability, whereas removing the trust region mechanism can lead to collapse. Moreover, ratio-based clipping can fail in fully on-policy training: the importance ratio stays at 1, so the ratio-based trust region constraint never activates. Under standard training settings where GRPO is stable, LGPO achieves comparable training stability and peak performance while reducing training time by ~

translated_title: 重要性比率对于大语言模型中稳定强化学习是否必要？
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）已成为大语言模型（LLM）后训练的核心技术。然而，像GRPO这样流行的RL方法需要同时计算旧策略和当前策略的似然以构建重要性采样比率，从而带来不可忽略的计算开销。在这项工作中，我们提出了似然门控策略优化（LGPO），它通过基于似然的门控机制施加软信任域约束，从而无需计算旧策略似然。实证结果表明，移除重要性采样修正项并不会损害训练稳定性，而移除信任域机制则可能导致训练崩溃。此外，基于比率的裁剪在完全on-policy的训练中可能失效：重要性比率始终保持为1，因此基于比率的信任域约束永远不会被激活。在GRPO保持稳定的标准训练设置下，LGPO实现了可比的训练稳定性和峰值性能，同时将训练时间减少约（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 提出似然门控策略优化（LGPO），用基于似然的软信任域约束取代重要性采样比率，省去旧策略似然的计算，在保持训练稳定性和峰值性能的同时显著降低训练时间开销。
en_tdlr: Proposes Likelihood-Gated Policy Optimization (LGPO), which replaces importance sampling ratios with a likelihood-based soft trust region, eliminating old-policy likelihood computation and reducing training overhead while maintaining training stability and peak performance.
